outcome: atypical presentations of subcutaneous fat necrosis of the newborn (SCFNN)
bony involvement resembling Langerhans cell histiocytosis
cohort: This study reports on two preterm infants who experienced perinatal asphyxia.
finding: This case series describes two preterm infants with perinatal asphyxia who developed atypical presentations of subcutaneous fat necrosis of the newborn, including bony involvement and a large haematoma, which were initially misdiagnosed.
